## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results. For UI changes, state the Windows version, theme and display scale inspected, or explain what remains untested.

## Impact

Mention changes to startup, idle CPU, memory, executable size, local storage, networking or dependencies when relevant.

- [ ] I reviewed the change and have the right to contribute it under the applicable license.
- [ ] Imported material has source, version and license notices.
- [ ] No private clipboard data, credentials, machine-specific paths or generated build/profile directories are included.
